title: pH
content: pH describes acidity or alkalinity. The current demo pH is 7.18, close to neutral. Interpret pH together with the other monitored parameters and the model result.

title: Turbidity
content: Turbidity indicates cloudiness associated with suspended particles. The current demo turbidity is 2.4 NTU. A persistent rise should be investigated rather than relying on a single reading.

title: TDS
content: TDS represents total dissolved solids. The current demo TDS is 318 mg/L. TDS is one contextual indicator and is not, by itself, a complete potability test.

title: Temperature
content: Temperature is monitored as a contextual water-quality parameter. The current demo value is 26.4 C.

title: CNN-LSTM prediction
content: The proposed hybrid CNN-LSTM model extracts useful features from multi-parameter sensor data and learns temporal patterns. It classifies water as Safe or Contaminated and returns a confidence score.

title: Agentic AI
content: The Agentic AI layer coordinates monitoring, decision, recommendation and feedback functions. It uses prediction results, thresholds and retrieved knowledge to produce explanations and actions.

title: RAG knowledge retrieval
content: The project proposes Retrieval-Augmented Generation with sentence-transformer embeddings and a vector database to retrieve water-quality standards, contamination information, recommendation rules and historical records.

title: IoT communication
content: The proposed sensing node uses ESP32 with pH, turbidity, TDS and temperature sensors. Sensor readings are transferred using Wi-Fi/MQTT to the cloud/database for processing.

title: Alerts
content: Decision and alert generation combines CNN-LSTM prediction confidence, predefined water-quality thresholds and retrieved knowledge. If contamination is indicated, recommendations and alerts can be sent to users and water authorities.
